benchmark.paper: Jason Weston et al., Towards AI-Complete Question Answering: A Set of Prerequisite Toy Tasks, arXiv:1502.05698
benchmark.configuration: en-10k fit/validation; independent generated structured confirmatory challenge

byte_freeze.rule: Verify the official v1.2 en-10k archive by complete SHA-256 and byte size. Preserve official train/test source files; derive validation deterministically from whole training story blocks and hash every source and derived split.

task3.split_unit: whole story block; all questions/support lines remain together

task5.split_unit: whole story block; all questions/support lines remain together

freeze_artifact.note: Verified artifact generated after the structured input schema was added; contains the eight frozen source/derived split files and updated manifest.

benchmark.archive_mirror_note: The Hugging Face staff-hosted archive object has a distinct LFS digest but its CDN currently returns 403. The official v1.2 S3 archive contains the en-10k Task 3/5 train/test splits. The convenience en-valid-10k split is not used; validation is derived deterministically from whole training stories.
benchmark.archive_object_revision: official v1.2 archive mirrored by S3; immutable SHA-256 pinned

partition_policy.fit: 1800 complete en-10k training story blocks per task
partition_policy.warm_start: 1200 whole stories selected deterministically by SHA-256 story-ID ranking
partition_policy.online_adaptation: 600 disjoint whole stories remaining after warm-start selection
partition_policy.validation: 200 complete whole-story blocks derived from en-10k training source
partition_policy.confirmatory: 200 generated structured stories per task, 5 queries/story, fixed seeds 953900/953901; not an official bAbI test set
partition_policy.quarantined: Official en-10k test files retained as preprocessing/debug-only provenance and excluded from all campaign metrics
partition_policy.leakage: Whole stories remain in one partition; generated confirmatory bundle contains no gold labels before G4.

selected_tasks.name: Three Supporting Facts
selected_tasks.reasoning_target: temporal object-state reconstruction from a multi-event story

QUERY.anchor_event: story_id:source_line_id for the target MOVE, independently annotated from query semantics; not taken from the gold supporting-fact column
QUERY.input_exclusion: Gold supporting line IDs and answer are evaluation-only metadata and must not be passed to HLA/HLB

selected_tasks.name: Three Argument Relations
selected_tasks.reasoning_target: typed three-participant relation binding and role-conditioned retrieval

QUERY.temporal_policy: select the most recent observed GIVE event matching all bound roles, ordered by event_time then event_id
QUERY.input_exclusion: Gold supporting line IDs and answer are evaluation-only metadata and must not be passed to HLA/HLB

stages.name: Byte acquisition and immutable freeze
stages.gate: archive and six selected split files have verified SHA-256 digests and exact row counts

stages.name: Oracle structured-event adapter
stages.gate: complete structured event/query annotation bundle matching structured_input_freeze schema, with story-scoped provenance and no gold answer/support leakage; annotation manifest and hashes frozen

stages.name: Deterministic reference solver
stages.gate: reference solvers pass temporal and n-ary role tests, including repeated target destinations, late observations, repeated GIVE relations and same-event role integrity; official support indices used only after prediction for witness scoring

stages.name: HLA/HLB matched structured-input campaign
stages.gate: same frozen records, query set, seeds and resource limits; report each architecture separately

stages.name: Text parsing evaluation
stages.gate: introduced only after B-D; parser errors scored separately from memory/reasoning errors

partition_policy.source_splits: Use official train, valid and test files as provided. Never repartition individual questions across story boundaries.
partition_policy.validation: valid only; used for model/threshold selection
partition_policy.confirmatory: test only; accessed once after configuration freeze
partition_policy.leakage: A story and all its questions/support indices remain in one source split.

claim_boundaries: Structured-event results do not measure natural-language parsing.
Task 3 evaluates temporal multi-fact reasoning; Task 5 evaluates n-ary role binding, not arbitrary semantic understanding.
Generated fixtures validate adapters and solver mechanics but are not official benchmark evidence.
No HLA/HLB winner is selected from a single task or unmatched workload.
Official-data claims require verified source bytes, hashes, row counts and provenance.
The raw bAbI supporting-fact indices and answers are held out as evaluation metadata; neither may be supplied to structured HLA/HLB inputs.
Task 3 query anchors identify the target movement event independently of the official support-index column; Task 5 answers use the latest observed same-event role match.

task3_query.target_event_id_rule: independently annotated from query semantics and story timeline; must not be copied from official supporting-fact indices

task5_query.temporal_policy: most recent observed same-event GIVE matching all bound roles

leakage_controls.source_provenance: every event and query must retain story-scoped source line identity
leakage_controls.text_parser: not part of structured-event campaign; text parsing is a later separately scored stage

structured_input_freeze.annotation_protocol: Structured event/query annotations must be frozen independently of model runs, preserve all story events and role bindings, be checked against source lines by an independent reviewer, and record annotation version and reviewer agreement. The official support indices and answer column are evaluation-only.

data_identity.confirmatory_source: independent structured generator; no labels emitted before G4

partitions.fit: 1800 complete stories per task, deterministically derived from the official 2000-story training source
partitions.validation: 200 complete stories per task, disjoint from fit and derived with HLG-BABI-T3-T5-VALIDATION-v1
partitions.confirmatory: 200 official test stories per task; held sealed until protocol, code, candidate choice and validation report are frozen
partitions.split_unit: whole story block; no story, event, query or support line may cross partitions

seeds.fit_order: For each seed, deterministically permute complete fit stories using a documented SHA-256 ranking; preserve within-story source order
seeds.pairing: Identical per-seed story permutations and event/query order for HLA and HLB
seeds.confirmatory_order: Fixed source order; no seed-dependent reordering

input_contract.mode: typed structured events and queries; no natural-language parser in this campaign
input_contract.story_scope: Every event/query ID is story-scoped and preserves exact source-line provenance
no_leakage: any annotation derived from gold support indices
input_contract.task3_query: OBJECT_LOCATION_BEFORE_MOVE: object_id, destination_id, target_event_id independently identified from query semantics; answer is object location immediately before that exact MOVE
input_contract.task5_query: GIVE_ROLE: all bound roles and answer_role; answer roles are never included among bound roles; match all constraints within one GIVE event
input_contract.labels: Gold answers and support IDs are evaluator-only and become visible only after prediction; fit labels may update task-outcome calibration only after scoring

runtime.warm_start: fit_* APIs consume warm-start partition only; then process warm-start dynamics with learn=false
runtime.online_adaptation: 600 disjoint fit stories, source order, director.exchange(learn=true)
runtime.validation: 200 stories, director.exchange(learn=false), score-only, no learner/eligibility/task-calibrator updates
runtime.confirmatory: generated inputs only before G4; score-only after candidate freeze
runtime.hlb_evidence: single canonical persistent store, story-scoped retrieval, capacity 65536
runtime.soe_native: freeze SOE configuration, native kernels, cross-level gains, dt and feature dimensions

learning: L0 feature forecast error by horizon
L1 event type and complete role-binding exact accuracy
L2 context-transition accuracy where target exists
per-channel prediction loss and update counts
efficiency: runtime wall time; not a matched cost study

selection.rule: Select one candidate per architecture and task using validation exact-answer accuracy first, then integrity gates, then L1 role/event forecast accuracy; tie-break by lower abstention and then stable candidate ID.
selection.integrity_veto: Any false exact witness, cross-story contamination, leakage violation, role mix-up above zero on exact-query cases, or evidence/provenance integrity failure rejects the candidate regardless of accuracy.
selection.confirmatory: After candidate selection, freeze candidate fingerprints, protocol, data/annotation manifests, metrics and code commit. Run official test once. No retuning or promotion based on confirmatory outcomes.

reporting.paired_unit: story, clustered within seed; HLA/HLB compared on matched story IDs and seed permutations
reporting.uncertainty: Report per-seed scores, pooled micro and macro scores, paired story-level bootstrap 95% intervals, and exact denominators; do not treat repeated seeds on the same stories as independent confirmatory samples.
reporting.claim_boundary: Structured-event reasoning only; no natural-language parsing, open-world reasoning, general semantic understanding or architecture-wide superiority claim.

execution_gates: G0: verify official archive and en-10k fit/validation source hashes; quarantine official test
G0.5: verify fixed-seed generated challenge counts, novel vocabulary, input hashes and no labels emitted
G1: source-indexed fit/validation annotation, oracle audit and warm-start/online split freeze
G2: score-only acceptance, full CI, H1 evidence tests and compiled-native smoke
G3: ten-seed fit/online/validation campaigns and six ablations; freeze candidates
G5: publish artifacts and evidence ledger
learning_protocol.supersession_reason: The official en test files overlap the en-10k train/test story corpus (Task 3: 200/200 story blocks); both official test configurations are quarantined. Confirmatory evaluation uses an independent fixed-seed structured generator.

candidate_selection.rule: Pass integrity gates; require 100% exact structured query accuracy; maximise L1 complete relation/event-role forecast accuracy; minimise L0 feature error; minimise abstention; stable candidate ID tie-break.
candidate_selection.integrity_veto: Any false exact witness, cross-story contamination, leakage violation, role mix-up on fully specified queries or provenance failure rejects candidate.
candidate_selection.confirmatory: Generated challenge is evaluated once after candidate fingerprints and validation decisions are frozen.
